title: Maximum Subarray
statement: Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous subarray (at least one number) with the **largest sum** and return that sum.
idea: Walk through the array and keep `current_sum` = the best sum of a subarray that **ends at the current number**.

That best subarray either **extends** the previous one (`current_sum + num`) or **starts fresh** at this number (`num`). Starting fresh wins exactly when the sum carried so far is negative — a negative prefix only drags the total down.
The answer is the largest `current_sum` seen at any position.

complexity.timeWhy: One pass with O(1) work per number.

steps.text: Our example: **`nums = [-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4]`**. Each step runs one highlighted line of the code.
